claims.quote: Probably restricted to southern parts of Karnataka state and northern Kerala state in southwestern India.

regions.name: Netravathi
regions.quote: Following its redescription in 2015 (see 'Notes') it is known with certainty only from the Netravathi and Tungabhadra river systems in Karnataka although it is thought to occur elsewhere.
